mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Skill/m_Piercing.bmd: two meshes, 36 triangles, a cone down its own Z from -74 to 193. Its one bone, Box01, turns it 90 degrees about X (quaternion 0.707, 0, 0, 0.707) and sets it 21 units across and 31 up; game/fx/force.h lays the Z along his facing.
